title: Warrior Sword Dance Chant (Ka Rwai Shad Mastieh)
khasi_title: Ka Rwai Shad Mastieh Ki Riewshlur
cultural_context: Ancient heroic chant accompanying the Shad Mastieh (Warrior Sword Dance). Male warriors and clan elders hold naked double-edged steel swords (waitlam) in their right hands and black or silver yak-tail whisks (symphiah) in their left, dancing in fierce protective circles to symbolize the historic defense of the matrilineal home, clan borders, and sacred territory against invaders.
lyrics_khasi:
Kren ka Bom, sawa ka Tangmuri!
Ki samla shlur ki la ieng kynhoi;
Ka waitlam ha ka kti kamtrei,
Ka symphiah ba thaba ha ka kti kadiang!

Ngin iada ia ka Ri, ngin da ia ka Kur,
Ia ka Hok ngin ym ju aili ha ka khim!
Lada u nongshun u wan ban thombor,
Ka dohnud ba shlur kan ieng ha ka nam!
lyrics_english:
The giant bass drum thunders, the reed horn cries aloud!
The valiant warriors arise with a battle cheer;
The flashing steel sword brandished in the right hand,
The white whisk gleaming in the left hand!

We shall defend the homeland, we shall shield the Clan,
Never shall we yield Righteousness in times of peril!
If the enemy comes to oppress our sovereign soil,
Our brave hearts shall stand victorious in honorable renown!

stanzas.title: Ka Waitlam bad ka Symphiah (Sword and Whisk)
stanzas.khasi:
Kren ka Bom, sawa ka Tangmuri!
Ki samla shlur ki la ieng kynhoi;
Ka waitlam ha ka kti kamtrei,
Ka symphiah ba thaba ha ka kti kadiang!
stanzas.english: Bass drum thunders, horn sounds! Brave warriors rise cheering; flashing sword in right hand, gleaming whisk in the left!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingiada ia ka Kur (Defense of the Clan)
stanzas.khasi:
Ngin iada ia ka Ri, ngin da ia ka Kur,
Ia ka Hok ngin ym ju aili ha ka khim!
Lada u nongshun u wan ban thombor,
Ka dohnud ba shlur kan ieng ha ka nam!
stanzas.english: We defend our land, we shield our clan; righteousness we will never surrender! If foes encroach, our valiant hearts will stand in glory!

vocabulary.shad mastieh: Traditional warrior sword dance performed with naked blades and whisks
vocabulary.waitlam: Traditional heavy, broad-bladed Khasi battle sword with iron hilt
vocabulary.symphiah: Protective dance whisk made of horsehair or yak-tail set in an ornamental silver handle
vocabulary.ka bom: Massive hollowed-wood two-headed war bass drum struck with curved mallets
vocabulary.thombor: To invade, oppress, trample upon sovereign rights by brute force
